PASS on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/luccachiang__gsworld --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by null); no hardware run and no human review is claimed. The card's family-config decision and GymnasiumDriver helper fit the upstream Gymnasium environment, so there is no deviation from the card. native is the card's AST-confirmed entry gsworld.mani_skill.envs.tasks.real_fr3_env:RealFr3; RealFr3-v1 is registered with max_episode_steps=200000. The deployment selects the fr3_umi agent and pd_joint_delta_pos because that agent's controller configurations are in the clone; the class default robot_uids is panda. The fake backend is a pure-Python kinematic F0 stand-in for the class's reset/step/close surface and the external ManiSkill BaseEnv's action_space/observation_space; it returns the 18-value qpos/qvel observation. The card's mock_strategy prefers upstream-sim, but the upstream simulator needs ManiSkill 3.0.0b15, SAPIEN, PhysX, torch and downloaded assets, so only the package fake is served; the sim backend (gymnasium.make) was not installed or run. ACTION SPACE CAVEAT: the real action space is assembled by the external ManiSkill package, not declared in the clone. The clone states the Fr3Umi controller's physical bounds (arm delta -0.1 to 0.1, gripper -0.01 to 0.04), but not the normalisation or the exact action dimension. The fake therefore publishes a placeholder Box(-1, 1) of eight normalised values (seven arm deltas and one mimic gripper); the bridge's derived action.values limit has ref RealFr3-v1:action_space, not a clone line, and a sim-backend deployment must inspect the real environment's action_space before trusting it. NOT COVERED: SAPIEN/PhysX rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, actuators and constraints (the fake integrates joint deltas kinematically); the real state observation's controller-state field (the fake returns qpos/qvel only); the two 640x480 wrist and right cameras and the 640x480 render camera, including rgb, depth and segmentation arrays (the gymnasium bridge serves the scalar world state only); rendering; the upstream torch/numpy reset random stream (the fake uses random.Random, so a seed does not reproduce an upstream trajectory); wall-clock pacing (realtime_factor 0, ticks advance the configured 50 ms control step only); snapshot and restore (the environment exposes no get_state/set_state pair). The fake starts from fr3_umi_task_init_qpos plus placeholder noise; the upstream agent reset and keyframe selection are performed by the external ManiSkill BaseAgent and are not reproduced, and reset options are accepted and ignored by the fake. The task card records license_spdx NOASSERTION with license_class unknown; no separate licence determination was made. Expected warnings left intentionally, matching the Gymnasium family and the external base class: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset, so it makes no native call); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x6 for action_space, close, dt, observation_space, reset and step (they are inherited from the external ManiSkill BaseEnv, which is not defined in the clone; the clone calls reset, step and close and reads action_space); G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived inputs seed (reset), seed (seed class), ticks and action.values[*], which the bridge derives without units. G4 has no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. No catalogue requests: only cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run; gate.digest is the digest the last check printed.
